newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Canadian Prairie primary grain elevators rose to 30 percent in the week ended July 6, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
The 30 percent elevator vacancy rate was up from 29 percent on June 29, the Board said.
Manitoba had the most space at 37 percent, Alberta was next at 31 percent and Saskatchewan had the least at 23 percent.
Vancouver unloaded 3,219 railcars versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,256 railcars versus the 900 target. Thunder Bay unloaded 3,060 railcars versus the 3,420 target.
